disclaimer: INR amounts represent positioning target benchmarks in India. Charges are billed exclusively in Telegram Stars (XTR) through Telegram's in-app payment system. The exact Stars amounts are configurable and subject to commercial signoff.
cancellationPolicy: Subscriptions renew automatically every 30 days. You can cancel at any time directly in Telegram under Settings > Subscriptions. When canceled, your membership remains active until the end of the current 30-day billing period.
expirationPolicy: Upon subscription expiration or non-renewal, private Telegram channel access is automatically revoked.
refundPolicy: Telegram Stars payments are non-refundable digital goods per Telegram Terms of Service. Exceptional billing discrepancies can be reported via Grievance Redressal.
